scope: Every original frozen final; brief and exact plan govern. COMPONENT does not establish discovery effectiveness.
axes: Material original obligations and negative constraints
Consequential source facts, governing conditions, versions and applicability
Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, alternatives and implementation/failure history
Valid corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
Supported meaning retained from draft and criticism into the complete final
Meaningful proposed validation, with executed work distinguished
source_pass: No material unsupported claim, required omission, false rejection or preservation loss found under the declared assessment. Report nonmaterial limits. This is finite assessed quality, not universal correctness.
primary_context: Inspect governing primary docs/code plus adjacent definitions, versions, exceptions, callers/tests and consequential issue/fix/release history as needed. Counted citations or agreeing agents cannot establish truth.
coverage: Declare COMPLETE, PARTIAL or UNASSESSED for each axis and each consequential obligation/source family. A decisive failure may stop further expensive grading only when remainder explicitly UNASSESSED; failure labels do not imply comparable complete grades.
component_boundaries: Shared package creation is preparation. Assess cache/critique semantic preservation and method compliance separately; no discovery recall score for COMPONENT.
independence: Pair/block reviewer may share their own primary-source research across arms but freezes each original arm judgment independently before comparative selection. Imperfect blinding from paths/prompt/output is disclosed. No candidate repair or feedback to authors.
validation_boundary: The requested deliverable is a research planning proposal. Do not demand deployment or local physical intervention; unknown user data may remain unknown, while available mechanism research remains required.
original_immutability: Freeze assessment files and source evidence manifest before comparative analysis. Focused disputed-finding adjudication is separate, original unchanged. No repeat graders until pass.
promotion_rule: Lexicographic: no material scope weakening; demonstrated source quality and completion on both screen cases where available; then failure-inclusive latency/context/resource tradeoffs. Ties and missing telemetry explicit. A component lead is an integration hypothesis, never a full-pipeline win. If no credible confirmed optimizer, reserved cases run prospectively labeled diagnostic replication of least-dominated complete recipe. Lock before revealing held-out cases.
time: 60 minutes FULL and25 minutes COMPONENT are MAXIMUM elapsed allowances, early completion permitted, no minimum and no credit for waiting. Frozen attempts never receive retrospective clock corrections or source regrades.
cost: Separate latency, context occupancy, observable provider activity, tokens and billing. Unknown is not zero; failed/missing/capped/invalid/interrupted attempts remain assigned denominators. Fast FAIL and FAIL/FAIL cannot show equal-quality savings. Zero source passes yields undefined consumption per passing final.
privacy: No private routing identity, native full transcripts, tokens or machine state in public artifacts; governing public source license notices retained.
